issues.reason: Title text matches the published article exactly (verified against the AEA article landing page and Crossref), so there is no field-mixing or wording error. However 'United States' is not brace-protected, so a sentence-case/title-case-altering .bst style (e.g. plain, apalike) will lowercase it to 'united states' at typeset time. This is a capitalization-protection hygiene fix only, consistent with how this project's other reports (e.g. castelnuovo's 'U.S.', villaverde's 'VARs'/'ABCs') treat the same defect class.
